info.name: Virtual Office
info.summary: See who's around, right inside Talk.
info.description:
Give a Talk group conversation its own little office. Open it from a message menu, share it in chat, and see who's there. Enter as a character and move around without leaving Talk.
Walk over, wave, share a coffee, or ask “got 2 minutes?” before a call. The office shows when a Talk call is running; you can join it from the full office. You can also make offices for Teams and groups. Admins can enable an office for everyone.
Pick a character, claim a desk, or leave a short Today note. Find offices through Talk, Team pages, search, or the Dashboard.
Only members can enter their Team, group, or conversation office. Opening a link does not make you appear there; you choose Enter office. Virtual Office does not keep a history of visits or movement. The admin guide explains what optional features store and when that data is removed.
Requires Nextcloud 35. Talk 25 adds conversation offices and calls. Teams, Deck, and Client Push add other features. Group offices work without them.
info.author: Hoang Pham
